title: Festival Countdown
guardrail: Made-up prices. Real life is different.

intro.tagline: 3 days. ₹2,000. One festival to pull off.
intro.pick: Which festival is your family getting ready for?
intro.line1: Three days to the festival, beta! Here's {{money}} for everything. First, my list:
intro.line2: And if there's a little left... a small surprise for me? Keep the rest for fun with your friends.
intro.hint: Oh, and Mamu's family might drop in this year...

plan.title: Split the money
plan.sub: Put Ammi's {{money}} into jars. Whatever you don't put in a jar stays as spare in your pocket.
plan.ayesha: Keep a little spare. Something always comes up during festivals.
plan.needsEmpty: The Needs jar is empty. Ammi's list has to come from somewhere!

d1.title: 3 days to go!
d1.body: Laad Bazaar is busy, but prices are still normal.

d2.title: Festival rush!
d2.body: Everyone is shopping now. Prices are up 10%.

d3.title: Last day!
d3.body: The bazaar is packed and prices are up 25%. Lights are going up everywhere.

card.shopSub: Same thing, three shops. Tap one.
card.deferred: You put this off yesterday. It's still on the list.

daamfix.name: Daam Fix
daamfix.hello: One price for everyone. No haggling, sorry!

chacha.name: Chacha's stall
chacha.hello: Arre, come come! Best in the lane.

aunty.name: Aunty's stall
aunty.hello: Best quality in the whole bazaar!

sasta.name: Sasta Corner
sasta.hello: Cheapest in Hyderabad, guaranteed! Quick, quick!

aunty.refuse: No discount, beta. Quality costs money.

wheel.text: Giant wheel tonight, everyone! You coming?

biryani.text: Biryani at the big stall! Coming?

loan.text: Bro, lend me ₹100? I'll pay you back tomorrow, promise.
loan.history: Last time he paid back half.

covers.text: Light-up phone covers! We all get one?

mamu.text: Mamu's family just arrived! We need snacks for everyone.

torn.text: Bhaiya... the seam split before I even wore it!

ring.text: Three rings. Land one and win the giant teddy!

out.best: That's the best price on the street. Nice!
out.paidMore: Done, but you paid {{extra}} more than the cheapest good shop.
out.fakesale: "Was {{was}}" sounds like a steal, but a good one was {{best}} next door.
out.late: Waiting cost you {{extra}} more for the {{item}}.
out.borrowed: The {{to}} jar was short, so {{money}} came out of {{from}}.
out.later: Okay, later. Prices go up as the festival gets closer.
out.without: No {{item}} this year. Ammi will have to manage.
out.swap: Cheaper plan, same fun. Everyone's happy.
out.no: Money saved, but {{friend}} looks a bit hurt.
out.loan: You lent Sunny {{money}}. He says tomorrow...
out.loanNo: Sunny shrugs. Your money stays with you.
out.mamuSpare: Your spare money covered it. No stress!
out.mamuBorrowed: No spare left, so {{money}} came out of {{from}}.
out.rebuy: The cheap one cost {{cheap}}, and now another {{money}}. Paying twice hurts.
out.old: He'll wear his old clothes. The cheap one didn't last.
out.odds: About 1 in 12 players wins. Each try costs {{cost}}.
out.tossSkip: You walk past. The teddy stays on the shelf.

budget.name: Sticking to a plan
budget.rule: A plan only works if each jar does its job.

compare.name: Compare prices
compare.rule: Check two shops before you buy.

fakesale.name: Fake discounts
fakesale.rule: Compare the price, not the % off.

cheap.name: Cheap can cost more
cheap.rule: If it breaks, you pay twice.

early.name: Buy early
early.rule: Prices rise when everyone wants the same thing.

ask.name: It's okay to ask
ask.rule: A polite "any less?" can save money.

buffer.name: Keep a buffer
buffer.rule: Spare money stops surprises from breaking your plan.

swap.name: Saying no kindly
swap.rule: Suggest a cheaper plan instead of just refusing.

opportunity.name: Every rupee has a cost
opportunity.rule: Money spent on fun came out of something else.

lending.name: Lending is a risk
lending.rule: Only lend what you can afford not to get back.

odds.name: The odds favour the stall
odds.rule: Games of chance are built so most people lose.

borrow.title: The {{jar}} jar is short by {{money}}
borrow.sub: Borrow from another jar. It'll show up on your plan at the end.

toast.notEnough: Not enough money in all your jars.

scene.title: Festival morning!
scene.noSweets: An empty plate. Ammi is improvising.

lights.half: The cheap lights flicker. Half are dead.
lights.dark: No lights this year. The house is dark.

brother.new: Your brother, proud in his new outfit.
brother.old: Your brother in old clothes, a little sad.
brother.torn: Your brother's cheap outfit tore. He's in old clothes.

scene.gift: Ammi opens your gift and smiles.
scene.noGift: No gift. Ammi smiles anyway: "Maybe next year."
scene.teddy: The giant teddy sits in the corner.
scene.gullak: Ammi puts {{money}} left over into the family gullak.
scene.otherPlan: Someone who spent on fun first

report.lit: The Plan & Budget minaret is lit!
report.notLit: Not lit yet. Same game, new plan? Try again.

star.plan: Plan: borrowed ₹100 or less between jars

tips.ghar: buy Ammi's list early, before prices rise
tips.gift: keep the Gift jar for the gift
tips.dost: swap for a cheaper plan instead of saying no

report.title: Your plan vs what happened
report.sub: Green is spent within the plan. Striped is over the plan.
report.borrowed: You moved {{money}} between jars. That's where the plan bent.
